name: GT STEAM Academy (Providence)
description_short: A free five week summer learning program for Providence Public Schools students, with morning classes in engineering, law, math and reading taught by college and high school student teachers, and afternoons of art, sports, games and field trips. Kindergarten to grade 2 meet at D'Abate Elementary, grades 5 to 7 at Classical High School.
special_needs_notes: Not an Extended School Year program and does not meet IEP mandated ESY requirements; families list allergies and special needs on the enrollment form.
notes: Only students who attend Providence Public Schools can enroll. Monday to Friday 8:30 to 4:00, no cost, breakfast, lunch and materials provided, busing on the enrollment form. Two Providence sites: current K to 2nd graders at D'Abate Elementary, 60 Kossuth St. (02909); current 5th to 7th graders at Classical High School. The homepage invites families to sign up to hear when Summer 2027 enrollment opens.
